blogs.title: The 'Type 2' Misdiagnosis: 5 Clinical Clues That Suggest MODY
blogs.description: A deep dive into the physical and metabolic red flags that separate HNF1A-MODY from classic T2DM, focusing on the absence of acanthosis nigricans, normal BMI relative to glycemic burden, and glycosuria thresholds. Using this patient's presentation to challenge the 'obesity equals T2D' heuristic.

blogs.title: Database Blind Spots: How to Grade Novel MODY Variants Without ClinVar
blogs.description: An analysis of the case's novel HNF1A p.N270S mutation which was absent from public registries. We discuss how to apply ACMG guidelines and AI tools like AlphaMissense to interpret pathogenicity when standard databases are silent, bridging the gap between NGS data and clinical confirmation.

blogs.title: The Exeter Calculator Dilemma: When Probability Tools Underestimate Risk
blogs.description: Critical appraisal of the Exeter MODY probability calculator. We explore how the tool's reliance on White European data introduces bias and potentially missed diagnoses in Asian and other ethnic populations. How to triage genetic testing when the tool says zero but the pedigree screams MODY.

blogs.title: Drug-Target Re-Alignment: Why Switching from Insulin to GLP-1 Matters
blogs.description: A pharmacological breakdown of the initial insulin failure versus the GLP-1 receptor agonist success in this case. Discussing the mechanism of pediatric beta-cell burnout in MODY and why secretagogues (sulfonylureas) or incretins are superior to long-acting insulin in HNF1A-MODY contexts.

blogs.title: The SGLT2 Inhibitor Warning: Hidden DKA Risks in Hepatocyte Nuclear Factor Mutants
blogs.description: A safety alert derived from the 'Discussion' section regarding SGLT2 inhibitors. Analyzing the pathophysiology of glycosuria and reduced renal glucose thresholds in HNF1A-MODY, explaining why blocking SGLT2 activity can precipitate severe dehydration and DKA in these specific patients.

blogs.title: Pedigree Policing: Using Family History to Justify Genetic Sequencing
blogs.description: Examining the power of the vertical transmission of diabetes in this case (grandmother, mother, brother). A practical guide on how to use family history data to score likelihood ratios for genetic testing when standard autoimmune markers like GADA are negative.
